sources.title: USGS earthquake catalog: bounded 200-event October 2026 snapshot
sources.rights_basis: USGS-produced numerical catalog data; official policy places USGS-authored or produced data in the U.S. public domain. The query selects catalog=us and every returned net value was verified as us. No third-party media, trademark artwork, or personal records are included. Rights review is scoped to these saved data bytes, not everything on the domain.
sources.attribution: U.S. Geological Survey, Earthquake Hazards Program. Snapshot retrieved 2026-10-13; query window 2026-10-01 through 2026-10-11, earliest 200 matching events. Numerical facts may be revised by USGS.
sources.retrieval_method: HTTPS curl through environment-provided egress proxy; TLS verification enabled; --fail, --proto =https, size/time bounded; exact response bytes retained
sources.scope_note: The endpoint limit is 200; this is a bounded pilot, not a complete ten-day earthquake census.
